# Bid the elevation, the stories, and the scrape.

> Price an exterior house-painting job from extra stories, extra elevation square footage, scrape and prime, trim, shutters, and hard access — not a published $3,999 house special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper ranch quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
